reviews.author: Prophet
reviews.text:
I bought this battery 2 months ago and paired it with a 1000VA inverter, I run my gaming PC(650 Watts), 2 fans, 3 tubelights on it and so far no issues. I can't notice when the power goes out or returns.It lasts for about 10 hours with all devices on and normal usage on PC and about 5 hours with heavy loads/gaming. Initally the battery came with 50% charged and took about 5 1/2 hours to be fully charged(Charging current of 25A).If it fits your budget go for it.
